item.title: Jenny Martinez launches cookware line at JCPenney
item.description: Jenny Martinez, a cookbook author and creator, will visit two North Texas JCPenney locations on Feb. 21 and Feb. 22 to celebrate the launch of her new cookware and home collection, featuring meet-and-greets, food and raffles for prizes.

item.title: 'Clue' comedy mystery set for Winspear Opera House in Dallas
item.description: The murder mystery comedy "CLUE" will be performed at the Winspear Opera House in Dallas from June 16 to June 28, 2025, based on the 1985 Paramount Pictures movie and the classic Hasbro board game.

item.title: Bad Bunny tops Spotify charts, surpassing Taylor Swift
item.description: Bad Bunny has overtaken Taylor Swift to become the most streamed artist on Spotify globally for February 2026, following his Super Bowl performance, while Bruno Mars, The Weeknd and Swift remain the top three in monthly listeners.

item.title: Brands see massive sales spike after 2026 Big Game commercials
item.description: Brands paid more than $8 million for 30 seconds of airtime during the 2026 Big Game, according to new data tracking real-time consumer behavior.

item.title: Texas ranks fifth in country for exhaustion levels
item.description: Texas ranked as the fifth most exhausted state in the US in 2026, with residents showing high levels of fatigue in physical, mental, sleep, and nutrition-related areas.

item.title: Calloway's hosts free romantic gardening workshop
item.description: Calloway's Nursery is hosting a free "Brilliant Blooms: Shrub Edition" workshop at 21 locations across North Texas, providing couples with a hands-on experience to create a container garden together, led by Texas Certified Nursery Professionals.

item.title: Top 10 most‐streamed K‐pop songs putting drivers at risk
item.description: A new study from Jones & Swanson suggests that high-BPM K-pop songs may be distracting drivers and increasing unsafe driving behaviors, especially among teen and young adult drivers.

item.title: Cloudy skies and mild temps in store for D-FW
item.description: Expect mostly cloudy skies and temperatures in the upper 50s to low 60s as we head into the night.

item.title: The best last-minute Valentine’s flower delivery deals we could find
item.description: Bouqs and Urban Stems have great last-minute Valentine's deals.

item.title: 41% of Gen Z use buy now, pay later for dating costs
item.description: Americans are increasingly using debt and flexible payment plans to fund their romantic lives, with 41% of Gen Z and 43% of millennials using Buy Now, Pay Later services to afford their dates.
